post.description:
Every minute, from Cloud Scheduler: publishes events that weren't published right after
their change.

Daily, from Cloud Scheduler: sends flags the verifier hasn't acted on to it again, takes
out of the shared bank what a flag, report or opt-out raced, and forgets old notes of
processed events.

Pub/Sub pushes every event here. A failure answers with an error, so Pub/Sub retries it,
and moves it to the dead-letter topic after the subscription's maximum attempts. An event no
retry can handle is logged and acknowledged (handle_or_drop).
